_README: DIVE SITES — fill this in with a dive master, then commit.
This file ships EMPTY on purpose. The whole feature hides itself when
'sites' is empty, and every optional field is omitted from the UI when
it's null. Depth and level are safety information: a site with no depth
recorded shows no depth rather than inheriting a plausible default.
Nothing is ever inferred from anything else.
REQUIRED per site:
id, slug        unique; slug is lowercase-hyphenated
name            what divers actually call it
area            one of the app's area ids (west_end, sandy_bay,
west_bay, coxen_hole, french_harbour, oak_ridge,
punta_gorda, port_royal, camp_bay, dixon_cove,
palmetto_bay, milton_bight, johnson_bight, flowers_bay)
latitude,       decimal degrees. Approximate is fine — this is for
longitude       orientation on a map, not for navigation.
OPTIONAL — omit or set null when unknown, never guess:
kind            wall | wreck | reef | channel | pinnacle | swim_through
level           open_water | advanced | technical
minDepthMeters  shallowest point, metres
maxDepthMeters  deepest point, metres
shoreAccessible true if you can swim to it without a boat
summary         two or three sentences, in your voice
insiderTip      the one thing a local would say before you got in
marineLife      ["eagle rays", "seahorses"]
operatorSlugs   slugs from businesses.json for the shops that run it,
e.g. ["native-sons-diving", "coconut-tree-divers"].
These wire the two-way link between sites and shops.
active          false to hide a site without deleting it
A worked example is below under '_example' — copy its shape, delete the
key. Sources worth cross-checking: roatan.online/dive-site-map,
roatan-diving.com/dive-sites, roatan-octopusdiveschool.com.
